matchers.check: defaultAgent: an Omarchy default agent is configured
matchers.event: a Hyprland socket2 event name; counts every occurrence
matchers.classAny: with event: one comma-separated field of the event data equals one of these, case-insensitive
matchers.dataContainsAny: with event: the lowercased event data contains one of these
matchers.self: opened: the card is summoned after this step began

steps.text:
**SUPER** is the Windows key (⊞, next to ALT — ⌘ on a Mac).
It runs this whole OS. First: connect your AI.
- Press **SUPER+SPACE**
- Go to **Setup → Default agent**
- Pick one (Claude Code, Codex…)

Now the essentials.
- **SUPER+RETURN** opens a terminal — try it
Bonus: **SUPER+C / SUPER+V** copy-paste works everywhere, even in there.

Your browser has its own key.
- Press **SUPER+SHIFT+RETURN**

One more terminal: **SUPER+RETURN**.
Watch the windows share the screen evenly — no overlap, no dragging.
That’s tiling.

The move that kills the mouse:
- **SUPER+arrows** jump focus between panes
Bounce around a few times — watch the highlight travel.

Time to tidy up:
- Steer onto a window with **SUPER+arrows**
- **SUPER+W** closes it — no titlebar needed
Close TWO of them.

The front door of the whole OS:
- **SUPER+SPACE** opens the menu — apps, install, themes, setup
- Type any app’s name and launch it from there

Fresh desk:
- Press **SUPER+2** — or any number — for another workspace
(I’ll come along — I’m pinned.)

A clean context for anything — one project per desk works great.
- Hop back to the desk you came from (**SUPER+1**, or wherever)

The float trick:
- Arrow onto a window (leave me out of it 😅)
- **SUPER+T** pops it out to float
- **SUPER+T** again tiles it back

Last one — about me.
- Dismiss me any time: **Escape**
- Summon me back: **SUPER+H**
Go on — close me and call me back!
